create_split_rule: create a SplitRule with a grow dimension, threshold value, and comparison operator
build_dimensional_rule: build a DimensionalRule representing a min-max range along a single feature dimension
add_dimensional_rule: add a SplitRule to a DimensionalRule to tighten the min or max bounds
condition_composite_rules: condition a PyTorch tensor on CompositeRules to get a boolean mask of matching rows
add_composite_rule: add a SplitRule to CompositeRules returning an immutable copy with the new rule appended
